title: Open Hearts at Singithi Sevana Children’s Home
excerpt: Donating children’s books, games and a day of laughter to inspire imagination and a love for learning.
content: Open Hearts aimed to brighten the lives of children at Singithi Sevana Children’s Home. The initiative focused on donating children’s books to inspire imagination and foster a love for learning, while fun games and activities filled the day with joy and laughter.
